title: Measurement-Driven Sub-Network Selection for On-Premise Retrieval-Augmented Factory Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.02760v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-premise assistants can give factory workers conversational access to machine documentation, but models capable of the task rarely fit shop-floor hardware. We show that after structural compression and retrieval-grounded adaptation, model size is no longer a reliable predictor of adapted answer quality: general capability falls almost linearly with parameter count, while judged retrieval-augmented answer quality does not. We therefore treat deployment as a post-adaptation selection problem, committing one sub-network per device on judged answer quality and measured on-device throughput under a configurable general-capability floor and memory budget; rules that optimize size, speed, or quality alone each give up capability or throughput. A weight-shared supernetwork trained with sandwich-style in-place distillation keeps this selection inexpensive. In a manufacturing-manual case study, extraction costs 13.7 percent of the unpruned model

translated_title: 面向本地部署检索增强工厂智能体的测量驱动子网络选择
translated_abstract: 本地部署的助手可以让工厂工人通过对话方式访问机器文档，但具备该能力的模型通常难以适应车间硬件。我们表明，在经过结构化压缩和基于检索的适配之后，模型规模不再是适配后答案质量的可靠预测指标：通用能力随参数数量几乎线性下降，而评判得出的检索增强答案质量却并非如此。因此，我们将部署视为一个适配后的选择问题，在可配置的通用能力下限和内存预算约束下，基于评判答案质量和实测设备端吞吐量，为每台设备分配一个子网络；仅单独优化规模、速度或质量的规则都会牺牲能力或吞吐量。通过三明治式就地蒸馏训练的权重共享超网络使这一选择过程的成本保持在较低水平。在制造手册案例研究中，提取成本仅为未剪枝模型的13.7%。
tldr: 该论文发现结构压缩与检索适配后模型规模不再能可靠预测答案质量，因此提出基于实测答案质量与设备端吞吐量的测量驱动子网络选择方法，在通用能力和内存约束下为工厂车间设备分配最优子网络。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that after structural compression and retrieval-grounded adaptation, model size no longer reliably predicts answer quality, and proposes a measurement-driven sub-network selection method that assigns each factory device an optimal sub-network based on judged answer quality and measured on-device throughput under configurable capability and memory constraints.
